name: Željana Zovko - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the European Union, of the Agreement establishing an association between the European Union and the Principality of Andorra and the Republic of San Marino respectively
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on a new agreement linking the EU with Andorra and San Marino. It welcomes the deal, which would replace the old customs arrangements and give both countries access to the EU's single market similar to Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway. It asks for close checks on financial rules, money laundering and tax cooperation, and support for these very small states. It also says Monaco is welcome to join later.

- **What changes:** Andorra and San Marino gain broad access to the EU single market, under EU rules and oversight.
- **Who it affects:** Businesses, workers, consumers and financial firms in the EU, Andorra and San Marino.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's position feeds into the EU's decision to conclude the agreement; ratification follows.
